Title: Consensus Variability Among LLMs in Design Concept Selection  
Claim: For the availability and security scenarios, the LLMs showed notable disagreement, with only 2 of the 5 models agreeing on a single design concept.  
Evidence: "In questions 1 (availability) and 2 (security), the LLMs exhibit notable disagreement (2 out of 5 agreed)" / "Claude 3.7 and ChatGPT 4o favored active–active with conflict resolution, while DeepSeek and Gemini 2.5 Pro recommended sharded database with cross‑region replication."  
Labels: LLM consensus, Design concept selection  
Conditions: Based on the comparison of five LLMs in the study  
Limits: Only reflects the specific questions and models evaluated; does not generalize to all LLMs or scenarios
